The probe runs the real MessagePackGenerator on a source whose user-declared `public partial class MessagePack.GeneratedMessagePackResolver` already has [System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage], then asserts the output compilation has no errors.
summary: A user's own [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage] on their partial resolver compiles on base (1 of 1 probe passed) and breaks on the branch (1 of 1 failed, error CS0579 duplicate attribute)

details.probe_test: DuplicateExclusionProbeTests.UserExcludedResolverStillCompiles (scratch file, removed after the run; not part of the branch)

standalone_shape_probe.note: same result with a hand-written copy of the emitted shape, no generator

details.why_it_matters: ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute has AllowMultiple = false and attributes on all partial declarations of a type merge. The resolver (ResolverTemplate) and, by reading, the composite resolver (CompositeResolverTemplate) are partial classes the user declares, so a hand-written exclusion, the obvious workaround before this change, now breaks the build. Formatters are generator-only types and are not affected this way.
